title: Bridgewell Comfort Care Membership Fee Schedule
content:
Membership fees for HVAC Maintenance Agreements, by agreement level. All amounts are in US dollars.

| Agreement level | Annual fee | Monthly fee | Systems included | Additional-system annual fee | Maximum systems | Price-lock terms | Warranty holder discount rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Essential | 149.00 | 13.95 | 1 | 99.00 | 3 | 1 | 10% (0.10) |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Standard | 219.00 | 19.95 | 1 | 129.00 | 3 | 1 | 10% (0.10) |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Plus | 279.00 | 24.95 | 1 | 159.00 | 3 | 1 | 10% (0.10) |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System | 349.00 | 31.95 | 2 | 129.00 | 4 | 1 | 10% (0.10) |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System Plus | 429.00 | 38.95 | 2 | 159.00 | 4 | 2 | 10% (0.10) |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Premier | 549.00 | 49.95 | 3 | 179.00 | 5 | 2 | 10% (0.10) |

## What each figure means

- **Annual fee**: the annual membership fee for the included systems when paid in full.
- **Monthly fee**: the monthly membership fee for the included systems.
- **Systems included**: the number of HVAC systems the membership fee covers.
- **Additional-system annual fee**: the annual fee for each system beyond those included; one twelfth of it is added to each monthly fee.
- **Maximum systems**: the maximum number of systems on one agreement.
- **Price-lock terms**: the number of terms, counting the first, during which the membership fee does not change.
- **Warranty holder discount rate**: the discount on the membership fee for a customer whose homeowner service contract covers the heating system at the same address, stated as a decimal fraction (0.10 is ten percent).

## Reading the schedule across levels

- Bridgewell Comfort Care Essential, Standard and Plus each include one system and accept up to three systems on one agreement.
- Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System and Dual-System Plus each include two systems and accept up to four.
- Bridgewell Comfort Care Premier includes three systems and accepts up to five.
- The fee holds for the first term only on Essential, Standard, Plus and Dual-System (one price-lock term), and for the first two terms on Dual-System Plus and Premier (two price-lock terms).
- The warranty holder discount rate is ten percent on every level.

## Schedule questions

**On Bridgewell Comfort Care Standard, what does each system beyond the first add?** The additional-system annual fee of that level, 129.00 per system per term, because Standard includes one system.

**How many systems beyond the included ones can a Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System agreement carry?** Two: it includes two systems and its maximum is four.

**Is there a level on which an agreement may carry five systems?** Yes, Bridgewell Comfort Care Premier, whose maximum is five; every other level's maximum is three or four.
